headline: HuyenBao v11.9 — HuyenBao rebrand + choice hints + social cooldown
summary: Three changes: (1) the app is rebranded from MOGUL to HuyenBao across the header, PWA manifest, page metadata, AI prompts, and default @handle — gameplay terms like the 'Industry mogul' power tier are unchanged. (2) The '(Balanced 50/50)' risk word is removed from behind every AI-oracle / life-event choice button; the colour-code legend stays below the choices, and each choice now gets its own small danger/benefit hint line (pay cost, possible gain, possible loss, health hit — localised EN/VI/ZH). (3) The social spam-click exploit is fixed: one post per game day across all five post buttons, enforced in the engine (addPost guard) and in the UI (buttons disabled + cooldown note).
features: Rebrand: MOGUL → HuyenBao in header, layout metadata, PWA manifest, package.json, AI post prompt, default @handle, i18n headline, README title (no changelog-history entry added per request)

Choice hints: every choice in the event modal shows a compact hint line — quality (low risk / uncertain / high risk) + possible gains (money, fame) + possible dangers (pay cost, lose up to N, fame drop, hp loss) in EN/VI/ZH
Choice labels: risk suffix ('· Balanced 50/50' etc.) removed from behind every choice; colour coding + bottom legend remain

Social exploit fix: POST_COOLDOWN_DAYS = 1 game day; addPost() engine-side guard (console hook cannot bypass); all 5 post buttons (AI / Update / Hype / Charity / Milestone) disabled during cooldown with a localised countdown note
Version bumped to v11.9 on homepage header + version.json
